Black and red ink are used in the text and in ornamentation
Originally belonged together with the following
Palimpsest throughout with undertext in Greek (GK)

Quire numbers in Syriac numerals on the first page of each quire, bottom margin (presumably, by the scribe John bar Manṣūr), and occasionally in Coptic numerals on the first page of each quire, top margin. Quires of 8 folios except quires III (10 ff.) and XX (7 ff.).
Traces of ruling with hard point marking borders of the columns and individual lines (direction: vertical)
